understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate the grid and complete every level by stepping onto each goal cell while carrying a piece whose shape, color, and rotation exactly matched the goal's requirements.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was performed one tile at a time using directional actions, with walls blocking movement. Shape modifier tiles cycled the piece's shape, color modifier tiles cycled its color, and rotation modifier tiles rotated it 90 degrees clockwise. A goal was completed only when all three attributes matched simultaneously upon entering its cell. Each action consumed stamina, including blocked moves; when stamina reached zero, a life was lost and stamina reset. Losing all lives ended the game.
